Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 586 of 2023
Applicant :- Jitendra Alias Jitendra Kumar Gupta
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, U.P. Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Satish Kumar Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jayant Singh Tomar, learned AGA-I for the State.

2. On 02.03.2023, after hearing the learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. this Court had passed the following interim order - "Heard learned Counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State/respondent as well as perused the record.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed by the applicant apprehending his arrest in F.I.R./Case Crime No?0007 of 2018, under Section 420,
467, 468 and 34 I.P.C. under Section 66 of Information Techonolgy (Amendment)
Act, 2008, Police Station Cyber Crime Police Station, District Lucknow.

1
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that First Information Report was lodged in the year 2018 since then police is harassing the applicant.
Th applicant has no criminal history except one case which has been explained in the bail application.

He submits that aggrieved by the harassment given by the police the applicant has filed Cri. Misc. Writ Petition No. 28705 of 2018 (CRLP), Jitendra Kumar Gupta vs. State,
which was disposed of as infructuous vide order dated 4.10.2018 on the statement of learned A.G.A. who has made statement on the basis of written instruction, which was taken on record, that investigation is going on and no incriminating material has been found which indicates culpability of the petitioner.

entities.text: Cri. Misc. Writ Petition No. 28705 of 2018 (CRLP)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A has opposed the bail prayer and prays for fifteen days' time to file Objections/Counter Affidavit.

On due consideration to the statement of learned A.G.A. in Cri. Misc. Writ Petition No. 28705 of 2018 (supra) so also the fact that the investigation since 2018 is still going on, in interest of justice, as an interim protection, till the next date of listing, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/investigating officer/S.H.O.
concerned with the following conditions:-
The applicant shall cooperate in the investigation and she will not influence the witness.

entities.text: Cri. Misc. Writ Petition No. 28705 of 2018
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The accused-applicant will remain present within 20 days' from today before the Investigating Officer concerned, failing which, the benefit of this order shall not be available to the applicant The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the Court.

Learned A.G.A. shall file Objections/ Counter Affidavit in the meantime."
3.

Although a counter affidavit has been filed in connected application, nothing has come to light which may persuade this Court to take a view, different from the view taken while passing the aforesaid order, nor the learned A.G.A. has pointed out violation of any of the conditions of interim anticipatory bail committed by the applicant.
4. In view of the aforesaid circumstances, the interim order dated 02.03.2023 is hereby made absolute and the application is allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.
5. In case, the applicant has not furnished bail bonds, he shall appear before the trial court and submit bail bonds within a period of two weeks from today.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Pradeep/-
